properties.name: crm.user.cleanup-interval
properties.description: Time between two runs of the task that deletes the users without an open socket, as an ISO-8601 duration, default = "PT1M"

properties.name: crm.user.disconnect-grace-period
properties.description: Time a user can stay without an open socket before the cleanup task deletes it, as an ISO-8601 duration, default = "PT5M"

properties.name: crm.communication.origin
properties.description: Client origin that REST and the socket allow, with credentials. It is an explicit origin, never "*", because browsers refuse cookies with it
